question: Which country recently became the 107th member of the International Solar Alliance?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Moldova**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Moldova Joins International Solar Alliance as 107th Member.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Moldova** has become the **107th member** of the **International Solar Alliance (ISA)**.

 
 
• 
 
ISA was launched in **2015** by **India and France** during **COP21 in Paris**.

 
 
• 
 
The Alliance aims to promote **solar energy development** globally.

 
 
• 
 
It focuses on reducing **technology and financing costs** for solar energy.

 
 
• 
 
ISA supports **sustainable energy adoption** in both developed and developing nations.

 
 
• 
 
Moldova will benefit from **technical assistance**, **financial frameworks**, and **multilateral partnerships**.

 
 
• 
 
The goal is to **expand Moldova’s solar capacity** through ISA cooperation.
